name: Arweave
source: https://arweave.org/_astro/glyph.BQkrfr-b_Z18YQcN.svg (the Glyph drawing of the official brand kit page https://arweave.org/brand-kit)
notes: Arweave: the two #222326 glyph paths (the ring and the 'a') of the kit's Glyph drawing, copied unchanged and placed on the 64 grid; its grey guide lines, dimension labels and the stand-alone 'a' are left out. The kit's logotype drawing (/_astro/logotype.CcaqzKFe_ZlzTfe.svg) has the same glyph
ArweaveMono: the same two paths in currentColor
The kit's download zips (GlyphSVG.zip, ArweaveSealSVG.zip, ArweaveALL.zip and the rest) return 404, and its seal SVGs only wrap PNGs (accessed 2026-10-09)
The arweave.org header (inline <svg viewBox="0 0 184 32">) strokes a slightly heavier ring; the previous artwork approximated that header symbol, which differs from the kit glyph
